displayIdentity.body: Restoration, burdens, testing, and sowing. Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted. So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.
